required_corrections: 5:64 is a contested/polemical verse: it opens 'The Jews say: Allah's hand is chained' (قَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ). Building the article's third leg on it without the site's contested-verse care invites the quote-mine 'AyahGuide celebrates a verse against the Jews.' Frame the 'fire for war' per classical tafsir as sedition/warmongering they instigate, acknowledge the historical context, and avoid ethnic-condemnation optics. This is the single most important fix.

Downplay/drop the 2.79% base-rate-as-marvel framing. The 3/3 نور co-occurrence is semantically expected — atfa'a MEANS 'extinguish,' whose natural objects ARE light and fire — so it is near-tautological, not a statistical improbability. A one-tweet rebuttal ('of course you extinguish light or fire') defeats the base-rate angle. Keep the load-bearing payoff (morphology: root-3/3 vs lemma-2/1 split, plus the agent/object flip); cut the statistical mystique.

Soften authorial-intent language ('the Quran uses that closeness deliberately'). Intent is not provable from counts. Present it as a tadabbur observation of a real pattern, not a demonstrated claim of deliberate divine punning.

Keep the nur/nar distinction strictly MORPHOLOGICAL, not phonetic. State it precisely: surface نور vs نار differ by one weak letter (و vs ا), both from underlying root ن-و-ر; nūr realizes the waw as long /uː/, nār shifts it to alif /aː/. Do not dramatize 'they sound almost the same.' (Risk note already flags this — hold the line.)

Do not imply the root ن-و-ر produces only two words: it yields نُور (light), نار (fire) AND مُنِير (luminous, 6×). Frame light/fire as two members of one luminous root-family, not the root's only children.

Scope the count to the verb/root طفأ; do not claim atfa'a is the Quran's 'only' word for extinguishing. The 'exactly three' claim is airtight for this lexeme (verified exhaustively incl. variant roots) — keep it lexeme-scoped.
notes: Every load-bearing claim re-derived from scripts/.corpus-cache/quranic-corpus.json and confirmed. Root طفأ occurs in exactly and only 3 verses (5:64, 9:32, 61:8), all lemma أَطْفَأَ — verified against variant spellings طفا/طفي (0 hits), so the complete-set claim is exhaustive. Agent/object structure holds perfectly: people→light→fail (Allah completes His light) x2; Allah→fire→done x1. nur/nar shared root ن-و-ر is corpus-consistent (145/145 نار tokens root نور) and classically grounded. Root-3/3 vs lemma-2/1 split and base rate 2.79% both exact. No overlap with 185 published slugs or the 6 week-shipped slugs; Quran-only payoff, no hadith. Bonus: the imperfect-attempt (9:32/61:8) vs perfect-accomplished (5:64) aspect contrast actively strengthens the thesis and should be foregrounded. The corrections are craft/framing and sensitivity guards, not defects in the linguistic core — none is load-bearing, so the proposal SURVIVES.
